//: CONVENTIONS rule 8 ledger — the written justification for every workspace dependency (runtime OR dev). Surfaced at milestone exit for the 30-second G-M owner glance (decision 0051/F44). Internal @ingame/* packages are auto-justified. Format: name → why needed · why no stdlib/existing path · provenance.
@react-navigation/native: The navigation engine expo-router already runs on (hoisted transitively); declared because the P6/R4 focus gate (src/render/animated.tsx useSurfaceFocused) imports NavigationContext directly — rule 8: declare what you import. No new install, the version pins what expo-router resolves. Provenance: the React Navigation team (expo-router’s own dependency).
typescript: The language + tsc typecheck/build (CI six-check steps 1 & 6). No stdlib equivalent. Provenance: Microsoft.
tsx: Run TS entrypoints (dev server, db:migrate, db:reset, drizzle scripts) without a build step. Avoids a compile-to-JS dance in M1. Provenance: privatenumber/esbuild.
esbuild: Bundles the API's PRODUCTION deploy artifact (apps/api/scripts/build-prod.mjs → dist/server/{index,migrate}.js; G-C / Railway). Not a substitute for tsc — tsc still typechecks and emits declarations — but tsc CANNOT produce a runnable Node artifact here: the repo is authored under `moduleResolution: "Bundler"`, so every relative import is extensionless and tsc never rewrites specifiers, which makes `node dist/src/index.js` die on the first import under ESM (Node dropped --experimental-specifier-resolution in v20). The alternatives were rewriting 640+ specifiers across 157 source files or shipping a custom ESM resolve hook into production. All runtime deps stay external; only our own source + @ingame/shared are inlined. Already in the tree transitively (vite/vitest's engine); declared direct because our own build script imports it. Provenance: evanw/esbuild.
typescript-eslint: TypeScript-aware ESLint integration + recommended rules (lint step). Provenance: typescript-eslint org.
eslint-plugin-react-hooks: Runs react-hooks/rules-of-hooks (ERROR) on the mobile route files (apps/mobile/app/**) — the guard for the F-16 logout-crash class (a Hook after an early return; commit 00d75f0). exhaustive-deps runs as a warning. The root eslint pass ignores apps/mobile/**, so the client keeps its own mobile-local flat config; no stdlib/existing rule catches hook-ordering. Provenance: Meta (React team).
@typescript-eslint/parser: The TSX-aware parser the mobile-local ESLint flat config (apps/mobile/eslint.config.mjs) needs to lint app/**/*.tsx route files for react-hooks rules — the default espree parser can't read TS/JSX. Declared direct since the config imports it (rather than leaning on the hoisted typescript-eslint transitive). Provenance: typescript-eslint org.
@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin: Registered in the mobile-local ESLint flat config ONLY so the inline `eslint-disable ... @typescript-eslint/*` comments already living in apps/mobile/src/** (e.g. no-explicit-any suppressions in render/theme/component files) resolve to a known rule instead of erroring 'rule not found' — a prerequisite for broadening the hook-lint guard's scope from app/** to src/** (F-16 crash class). NONE of its rules are enabled (surgical scope: react-hooks only). Declared direct since the config imports it, matching the @typescript-eslint/parser precedent (rather than leaning on the hoisted typescript-eslint transitive). Provenance: typescript-eslint org.
eslint: The general-quality linter (CI six-check step 1; the InGame [LINT] rules are custom in tools/lint). Provenance: ESLint org.
@eslint/js: ESLint's official recommended JS ruleset for the flat config. Provenance: ESLint org.
globals: Canonical global-identifier sets for the ESLint flat config (node/browser). Provenance: sindresorhus.
eslint-config-prettier: Turns off ESLint rules that conflict with Prettier so formatting + linting don't fight. Provenance: Prettier org.
prettier: Code formatter — one consistent style across the monorepo. Provenance: Prettier org.
vitest: Unit + integration test runner (CI six-check steps 2 & 3); first-class ESM/TS + Vite resolution for the workspace packages. Provenance: Vitest org.
vite: The build + dev server for the admin console (apps/admin — the external SPA of decision 0081). The console is a plain static SPA hosted apart from the phone app, so it needs its own bundler; vite is already in the tree transitively (vitest's engine) and reuses the same config/plugin/resolve stack the tests run on. No Expo/Metro path applies — that toolchain is the mobile client's. Provenance: the Vite team (vitejs).
@vitejs/plugin-react: React fast-refresh + the automatic JSX transform for the admin console's Vite build (apps/admin). Vite ships no React support out of the box; the alternative (hand-configuring esbuild's jsx options + no HMR) is strictly worse. Provenance: the Vite team (vitejs).
@types/react-dom: react-dom type definitions — needed by the admin console (apps/admin), the only workspace that renders React to the DOM (createRoot). The mobile client renders through React Native and declares only @types/react. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
@testing-library/react: Behavior-focused component testing for the admin console (apps/admin) — the DOM counterpart of the mobile client's @testing-library/react-native, and the same testing-strategy §2 posture (assert what an operator sees, not implementation detail). Provenance: Testing Library.
@testing-library/dom: The DOM query engine @testing-library/react declares as a PEER dependency (v16 unbundled it), so it must be declared directly rather than relied on transitively. Provenance: Testing Library.
jsdom: The DOM implementation the admin console's vitest project runs in (`environment: 'jsdom'`). Node has no DOM; the console's tests render real components and assert on real elements. Provenance: the jsdom project.
@types/node: Node type definitions for the server + tooling. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
zod: The single executable FE↔BE contract — request/response schemas (CONVENTIONS rule 3, decision 0046 #1). Provenance: colinhacks.
@node-rs/argon2: Argon2id password hashing for email/password auth (AUTH-01; product-spec §7 argon2/bcrypt). Native-but-prebuilt (napi-rs platform binaries, no node-gyp) so CI stays green on Linux + Windows; wrapped behind a PasswordHasher interface for swappability. No stdlib password KDF. Provenance: napi-rs/node-rs.
jose: Sign/verify the short-lived access-token JWT (AUTH-02); ESM-native, zero-dependency. Refresh tokens are opaque + server-stored (rotation/reuse-detection), not JWTs. No stdlib JWT. Provenance: panva.
pino: Structured JSON logging + request-ID correlation on the server (product-spec §7 observability; F18). The named logger; low-overhead, the Node standard. Provenance: pinojs.
@sentry/node: Server error tracking with request-ID correlation + PII/token scrubbing via beforeSend (product-spec §7 observability; F18). Env-gated on SENTRY_DSN — a no-op until the owner provisions the DSN (the F39-style provider carve-out). Provenance: Sentry.
express: The HTTP server framework for the API (product-spec §9, decision 0046 #2). Provenance: expressjs.
drizzle-orm: Typed SQL + the data-access layer; SQL-transparent + testable (decision 0046 #2/#7). Provenance: Drizzle team.
drizzle-kit: Generates + journals the committed migrations (decision 0046 #7; F28 journal check). Provenance: Drizzle team.
pg: PostgreSQL driver backing drizzle node-postgres. Provenance: brianc/node-postgres.
supertest: HTTP assertions against the Express app at the boundary — the integration heart (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: ladjs.
testcontainers: Throwaway real-Postgres containers so integration tests run against a real DB, not mocks (testing-strategy §2; F36). Provenance: Testcontainers org.
@testcontainers/postgresql: The Postgres module for Testcontainers (the integration PG container). Provenance: Testcontainers org.
compression: Response compression middleware (perf-round2 P2/S1): measured 5.9× gzip on the app's largest JSON payloads (N=2000 collection 3.5MB→599KB @ ~30ms CPU) — RN fetch decompresses transparently on both platforms. Node's stdlib zlib has no negotiate-Accept-Encoding/threshold/filter middleware — hand-rolling one re-implements exactly this battle-tested ~200 lines (content-type filter via `compressible` correctly skips the /media PNGs). Provenance: expressjs (the Express core team's own middleware).
expo: The Expo SDK — the React Native app platform + the Chrome/web dev loop + iPhone path (decision 0046 #2; item 7). Provenance: Expo.
expo-router: File-based navigation for the Expo client (product-spec §9). Provenance: Expo.
expo-linking: Deep-linking primitive required by expo-router (SDK 54 peer — the URL/route resolution the router builds on). Provenance: Expo.
expo-constants: App/runtime constants required by expo-router + the Expo runtime (SDK 54 peer). Provenance: Expo.
@expo/metro-runtime: Expo's Metro runtime shim required by expo-router for Fast Refresh + web/runtime bootstrap (SDK 54 peer). Provenance: Expo.
expo-status-bar: Status-bar component pulled in by the Expo app template. Provenance: Expo.
expo-sharing: Native OS share sheet for the CARD-21 branded share-image (F-8 E7b) — hands a local file URI to the platform share so the IMAGE travels, not a text line. RN-core Share.share carries only a message string (no image attach), so no stdlib/existing path. Bundled in Expo Go SDK 54 (no dev-client rebuild). Provenance: Expo.
expo-file-system: Writes the already-fetched branded share-image blob to the app cache so expo-sharing can hand its file URI to the OS share sheet (F-8 E7b, CARD-21). RN has no filesystem primitive; the legacy API (writeAsStringAsync + cacheDirectory) is the minimal path and avoids a re-download (the auth'd blob is reused). Bundled in Expo Go SDK 54. Provenance: Expo.
react: The UI runtime underpinning React Native. Provenance: Meta.
react-dom: React web renderer — required for the Expo web (Chrome) dev/test loop. Provenance: Meta.
react-native: The native client runtime (iOS/Android) (decision 0046 #2). Provenance: Meta.
react-native-web: Renders React Native components on web — the Chrome dev/test convenience surface (item 7). Provenance: Necolas.
react-native-safe-area-context: Safe-area insets dependency required by expo-router. Provenance: th3rdwave.
react-native-screens: Native screen primitives required by expo-router navigation. Provenance: Software Mansion.
@reduxjs/toolkit: State management + RTK Query (server cache) bound to the shared zod types (decision 0046 #2; F31). Provenance: Redux team.
react-redux: React bindings for Redux Toolkit. Provenance: Redux team.
redux-persist: Persist the client's drafts/cache slice locally, PURGED on logout + per-user namespaced + version-keyed (decision 0051/F20; product-spec §9). The auth tokens are NEVER persisted here — they live in expo-secure-store (F14). Provenance: rt2zz.
expo-secure-store: Access/refresh tokens at rest in the device secure enclave / keystore — NEVER redux-persist (decision 0051/F14; product-spec §9). Provenance: Expo.
@react-native-async-storage/async-storag: The redux-persist storage engine on React Native (F20; persist holds drafts/cache only, never tokens). Provenance: React Native Community.
expo-font: Load the design-system fonts (F-08). Provenance: Expo.
react-native-svg: Vector glyphs on the NavKeycaps (component-map §5.1 — the mockup `.nav-btn` svg icons; owner directive 2026-07-01) + the M4 card-composition render path ahead. RN has no built-in vector primitive; hand-rolled View shapes can't draw the compass/bag/friends arcs. Expo-SDK-54-pinned via `expo install` (15.12.1). Provenance: Software Mansion.
@shopify/react-native-skia: The CARD-15 flatten/render pipeline (M4 §1 spike, GO 2026-07-05): composition JSON -> skia -> flattened image (thumbnail + full) + effect/finish runtime overlays + the cap-30 PROOF size-ladder; offline client-flatten (P11). Included in Expo Go on SDK 54 (no dev build); web via CanvasKit. RN has no rasterizer, and the react-native-svg path can't makeImageSnapshot/flatten a composition. Expo-pinned via `expo install` (2.2.12). Provenance: Shopify.
@expo-google-fonts/chakra-petch: Chakra Petch — the on-screen typeface (F-08 / design-spec §1.2). Bundled font, no manual asset. Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/paytone-one: Paytone One — the shell/wordmark typeface (F-08 / design-spec §1.2). Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/press-start-2p: Press Start 2P — the PIXEL title face in the decision-0068 roster expansion (CARD-11 title fonts). Bundled TTF, loaded by fontId 'press-start' in useCardSkiaCtx. Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/bitter: Bitter — the SLAB serif title face (decision 0068 roster; fontId 'bitter'). Bundled TTF. Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/space-mono: Space Mono — the MONO/terminal title face (decision 0068 roster; fontId 'space-mono'). Bundled TTF. Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/pacifico: Pacifico — the SCRIPT/signature title face (decision 0068 roster; fontId 'pacifico'). Bundled TTF. Provenance: Expo.
@expo-google-fonts/allerta-stencil: Allerta Stencil — the STENCIL title face (decision 0068 roster; fontId 'stencil'). Bundled TTF. Provenance: Expo.
jest-expo: The Jest preset for Expo/React Native component tests (RNTL) — the client test runner (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: Expo.
jest: Test runner backing jest-expo for the RN component layer. Provenance: Meta.
@testing-library/react-native: Behavior-focused RN component testing (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: Testing Library.
react-test-renderer: React renderer used by RNTL/jest-expo to render components in tests. Provenance: Meta.
@types/react: React type definitions for the TS client. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
@types/jest: Jest type definitions for the client component tests. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
@babel/core: Babel core required by the Expo/Metro + jest-expo transform pipeline. Provenance: Babel.
babel-preset-expo: The Expo Babel preset the Metro bundler + jest-expo transform pipeline compile against (Expo SDK 54). Explicit dep after the SDK 52→54 upgrade pruned the transitive copy. Provenance: Expo.
react-native-reanimated: Locked-stack member (decision 0046 §2; product-spec §9). Required at M4 §3.2: @shopify/react-native-skia lists it as an optional peer but its NATIVE entry dereferences the reanimated module proxy at import time (external/reanimated/useVideoLoading.js createWorkletRuntime at module scope) — any on-device <Canvas> mount (CardFace wearing a composition, e9138ce) redboxes Expo Go with react-native-reanimated-is-not-installed. Web is unaffected (.web variant). Native side ships in Expo Go SDK 54; babel handled by babel-preset-expo. Expo-pinned via expo-install (~4.1.1). Provenance: Software Mansion.
react-native-worklets: Pinned DIRECT (0.5.1, + a root npm override) to match Expo Go SDK 54's bundled native side. Transitively required by react-native-reanimated 4.x; without the pin npm resolves 0.8.3, whose JS mismatches Expo Go's 0.5.1 native module and throws at init — skia's optional-dep proxy swallows that into "react-native-reanimated is not installed!" on every on-device Canvas mount. Reanimated 4.1.7 accepts 0.5–0.8. Expo-pinned via expo-install; drop the override when a dev build replaces Expo Go. Provenance: Software Mansion.
react-native-qrcode-svg: M6 P8 (SOC-07/10): client-renders the friend-invite QR from the POST /me/invites token/URL (OQ-073, find-add board P3) so an in-person add needs no link. Pure-JS QR encoder that draws through the already-present react-native-svg@15 (its only peer) — no native module, no dev-client rebuild, works in Expo Go + web. RN has no QR primitive, and hand-rolling a spec-correct QR matrix (Reed–Solomon ECC + masking) is exactly the wheel this avoids. The one sanctioned new dep for P8 (rule-08; G-M owner glance queued). Provenance: awesomejerry.
expo-apple-authentication: M6 auth-epic P-E (W-3, AUTH-03/09): the only Expo-blessed binding to Apple's native ASAuthorizationController — Sign in with Apple is HIG-mandated native UI (board OQ-035) and cannot be reproduced via fetch/stdlib or web views. Renders iOS-only behind isAvailableAsync(); requires the app.json config plugin + ios.usesAppleSignIn entitlement, so it only verifies end-to-end on the first EAS build (P16). Zero transitive additions (depends only on present expo core). SDK-54-pinned via `expo install` (~8.0.8). Provenance: Expo.
expo-crypto: M6 auth-epic P-E (W-3, AUTH-03): randomUUID + digestStringAsync(SHA256) for the SIWA nonce binding — the raw nonce POSTs to /auth/apple while its sha256 hex rides Apple's identityToken, which apple-verifier.ts asserts. RN has no node:crypto and no WebCrypto subtle digest, so a native-backed crypto primitive is required; hand-rolling SHA-256 in JS is the wheel this avoids. Zero transitive additions. SDK-54-pinned via `expo install` (~15.0.9). Provenance: Expo.
expo-dev-client: M1-P EAS/iOS dev-build lane (2026-07-22 sitting, m1p-provisioning-log §1/§4): the custom development client the eas.json `developmentClient: true` profile builds in (dev build `f9c012e6`) — REPLACES Expo Go for InGame on-device dev. Needed because SIWA (expo-apple-authentication, AUTH-03/09) rides a config plugin + the com.apple.developer.applesignin entitlement Expo Go can never carry — a dev build is the only way to exercise that native surface against Metro; no stdlib/existing path can add entitlements to Expo Go. Dev-tooling only: the launcher/dev-menu is excluded from release builds by design (the P16 production profile is unaffected). Added by the EAS build flow, SDK-54-pinned (~6.0.21). Provenance: Expo.
